phrases.text: Outlook just went down around the world.
But email itself is fifty-five years old.
In 1971, engineer Ray Tomlinson sent the first one, between two computers standing side by side.
To split the person's name from the machine, he picked the at sign.
And the first message? So boring, he forgot it.
Today, when email stops, work stops.
Could you last a day without email? Comment below, and subscribe for more.
